title: Cebu Pacific’s new 50-year franchise bill gets House final approval
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives has approved on final reading a measure seeking to renew for another 50 years the franchise granted to Cebu Air Inc., operating as Cebu Pacific.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives has approved on final reading a measure seeking to renew for another 50 years the franchise granted to Cebu Air Inc., operating as Cebu Pacific. During Monday’s session, 289 lawmakers voted to pass House Bill No. 11536, with no votes in the negative and no abstentions. READ: Cebu
